title: Bound label-reference listings without weakening reference guards
answers: Why does moving or deleting a prompt label produce an enormous error message?
How should label-reference parent listings be capped?
Do capped reference listings still prevent moving or deleting referenced labels?
body:
Symptom: Moving or deleting a prompt label produces an enormous error body when thousands of prompts reference it.
Root cause: products/ai_observability/backend/prompt_references.py:get_active_parents_referencing_label returned uncapped parent names that were joined into error messages.
Fix pattern: Order distinct parent names in SQL before slicing to MAX_ACTIVE_REFERENCE_RESULTS; this bounds message size and makes the selected names deterministic.
Constraints: The capped listing supports error messages, dialogs, and existence-based guards: references beyond the cap still yield a nonempty result. Do not treat it as a complete reference inventory.
applies: Active parent-name listings for prompt-label references, especially label-move and label-delete guards and messages.
